name: Thai Coconut Curry Pork Shoulder
note: In-band (548 cal / 6.1g carbs), braised pork shoulder in a coconut-milk Thai curry, no starch base; widens the American/Tex-Mex-skewed catalog with a Thai coconut-curry and adds the run's first pork braise/curry (accepted pork so far is sausage x2 + pork chop). Cross-lane merge: adjudicator flagged HIGH risk of a Thai coconut-curry twin in another protein. Checked - no accepted coconut-Thai-curry (burmese-chicken-dal-curry is a lentil-based Burmese dal, distinct; filipino-pork-adobo-sa-gata is vinegar-soy adobo, distinct). The pending pool candidate ground-turkey-thai-red-curry-cauliflower-skillet shares the coconut-Thai-curry sauce family but is a different dinner (quick ground-turkey + cauliflower skillet vs braised pork-shoulder in curry) - I judge it distinct enough to co-exist, and will re-confirm on its own decision. No collision blocks this keep.
